subject: Donate Life Month Proclamation
overview: Mayor Stephanie Muccini Burke met with representatives and volunteers from the New England Organ Bank to hear personal accounts of organ donation and officially proclaim April 2016 as Donate Life Month in Medford.

items.title: Introduction and Organ Donation Overview
items.summary: A representative of the New England Organ Bank highlighted the importance of organ and tissue donation awareness and donor registration through the Registry of Motor Vehicles.

items.title: Public Testimony from Donor Families and Recipients
items.summary: Volunteers and family members shared personal experiences regarding life-saving organ transplants and decisions to donate organs of deceased relatives.

items.title: Donate Life Month Proclamation
items.summary: Mayor Stephanie M. Burke proclaimed April 2016 as Donate Life Month in the City of Medford and presented the official proclamation to the New England Organ Bank.
